So what did this relationship do for me? It can be really scary to live half of a life in silence. What did it do for me?

It didn’t exactly compensate for my trauma but I know this relationship helped me maintain my self-worth through my trauma and I’m pretty sure this relationship has helped me too.

As it stands, I don’t want to go another day without finding myself a partner that makes me want to live as much as I do. I know that part of me wants to engage in this until they choose to be good and kind.

One day, it would be nice to just live my life with a person who welcomes me into their life without putting me down. I would say that hasn’t happened yet though and I’m not sure I’ll ever find it, either. My Korean friend nodded knowingly. "You look a little more confident," he commented as I looked out the window from behind Gyawa Gate, long uncomashed hair now pulled back. "You should really look more like this." The lighting moved excitedly, slightly sad, as he leaned over to look at the leafy mountain and his own head lagged. Well, look, I may have met other Sigma Riders in the area, but I didn't take this moment too well.
